BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride

Bowling Green, KY · Downtown

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride is a social group ride in Bowling Green, KY. It meets Mondays, 5:30–7:30 pm, in season, starting at Warren County Bike Safety Park at the Fringe. Pace: easy.

About the BikeWalkBG Weekly Community Women's Bike Ride group ride

A free women's community ride organized by the county's BikeWalkBG program from the downtown bike safety park. Family rides and a monthly seniors ride run from the same spot.
